questions.stem: What is the major difference between Data Mining and Data Science in terms of the data each works on?
options: Data Mining works only on unstructured data; Data Science only on structured data
Both work only on structured data
Data Mining is done only on structured data, whereas Data Science covers structured, semi-structured and unstructured data
Data Science works only on semi-structured data
questions.explanation: Data Mining is done ONLY on structured data, whereas Data Science is done on structured, semi-structured and unstructured data.

questions.stem: Which statement about the relationship between Data Science and Data Mining is correct?
options: Data Science is the superset of Data Mining
Data Mining is the superset of Data Science
Data Science is a technique within Data Mining
They are two names for the same thing
questions.explanation: Data Science is the superset of Data Mining, and Data Mining is a subset of Data Science.

questions.stem: Data Mining is also known by which other name?
questions.explanation: Data Mining is also known as KDD, Knowledge Discovery in Data.

questions.stem: Data Science is mostly tagged with Big Data. With which concept is Data Mining mostly tagged?
questions.explanation: Data Science is mostly tagged with Big Data, and Data Mining is tagged with Data Warehousing.

questions.stem: According to I Am Datapedia!, since when has Data Science existed, and when did Data Mining start?
options: Data Science since the 1990s; Data Mining since the 1960s
Data Science since the 2000s; Data Mining since the 1980s
Data Science since the 1960s; Data Mining since the 1990s
questions.explanation: Data Science has been there, either manual or not, since the 1960s, whereas Data Mining started in the 1990s for database folks.

questions.stem: In what tool was Data Mining first performed, before the introduction of the Data Warehouse?
questions.explanation: Data Mining was first performed in Excel; then, with the introduction of the DWH, an automated process started discovering historical patterns from large structured data sets.

questions.stem: Which of the following correctly contrasts Data Mining and Data Science?
options: Data Mining is a domain, whereas Data Science is a technique
Data Mining is a technique, whereas Data Science is a domain
Data Mining is a product, whereas Data Science is a service
questions.explanation: Data Mining is a technique, whereas Data Science is a Domain.

questions.stem: Data Mining focuses on optimising existing systems. What does Data Science focus on instead?
options: New ideas, new products and services
questions.explanation: Data Mining focuses on optimising existing systems, whereas Data Science focuses on new ideas, new products and services.

questions.stem: Which of the following is listed as part of Data Science but NOT as part of Data Mining?
questions.explanation: Data Science involves machine learning, AI, pattern recognition, statistics, visualisation, databases, KDD, data mining and neurocomputing; Data Mining involves KDD, databases and data processing, and machine learning.

questions.stem: Data Mining focuses on the process. What does Data Science focus on?
questions.explanation: Data Mining focuses on the process, whereas Data Science focuses on the science of the data.
